name: Acute Senses
description: Os sentidos vampíricos são excepcionalmente precisos.
descriptionEn: The vampire's predatory senses are exceptionally precise.

name: Altar
description: Um local consagrado para práticas do Círculo da Anciã.
descriptionEn: A place consecrated for Circle of the Crone practices.

name: Anointed
description: Reconhecimento religioso dentro da Lancea et Sanctum.
descriptionEn: Religious recognition within the Lancea et Sanctum.

name: Atrocious
description: A monstruosidade do personagem reforça sua presença predatória.
descriptionEn: The character's monstrosity reinforces her predatory presence.

name: Attaché
description: Experiência em etiqueta, favores e protocolo do Invictus.
descriptionEn: Experience with Invictus etiquette, favors, and protocol.

name: Bloodhound
description: Reconhece propriedades sutis do sangue pelo cheiro e sabor.
descriptionEn: Recognizes subtle properties of blood by scent and taste.

name: Cacophony Savvy
description: Sabe interpretar e utilizar os sinais locais da sociedade vampírica.
descriptionEn: Knows how to interpret and use local Kindred signals.

name: Carthian Pull
description: Mobiliza contatos e solidariedade dentro do Movimento.
descriptionEn: Mobilizes contacts and solidarity within the Movement.

name: Claws of the Unholy
description: Torna especialmente perigosas as armas naturais concedidas por Protean.
descriptionEn: Makes natural weapons granted by Protean especially dangerous.

name: Close Family
description: Laços fortes com a linhagem vampírica concedem apoio e reconhecimento.
descriptionEn: Strong ties to the vampiric lineage provide support and recognition.

name: Cutthroat
description: Prospera em disputas cruéis da sociedade dos mortos.
descriptionEn: Thrives in the ruthless contests of the dead.

name: Distinguished Palate
description: Prefere uma categoria específica de presa e percebe seu sangue com precisão.
descriptionEn: Prefers a specific category of prey and perceives its blood precisely.

name: Dream Visions
description: Recebe imagens proféticas durante o sono diurno.
descriptionEn: Receives prophetic images during daysleep.

name: Dynasty Membership
description: Pertence a uma dinastia reconhecida de mortos-vivos.
descriptionEn: Belongs to a recognized dynasty of the undead.

name: Enticing
description: O Beijo e a presença do vampiro são particularmente atraentes.
descriptionEn: The vampire's Kiss and presence are particularly enticing.

name: Feeding Grounds
description: Um território estável e conhecido onde o vampiro pode se alimentar.
descriptionEn: A stable, familiar territory where the vampire can feed.

name: Friends in High Places
description: Mantém relações úteis com figuras influentes.
descriptionEn: Maintains useful relationships with influential figures.

name: Haven
description: Um local seguro para o sono diurno, definido por localização, segurança e tamanho.
descriptionEn: A safe place for daysleep, defined by location, security, and size.

name: Herd
description: Mortais dos quais o vampiro pode se alimentar regularmente.
descriptionEn: Mortals from whom the vampire can feed regularly.

name: Honey Trap
description: Usa desejo e intimidade para conduzir vítimas a uma posição vulnerável.
descriptionEn: Uses desire and intimacy to maneuver victims into vulnerability.

name: Invested
description: Possui autoridade formal concedida pelo Invictus.
descriptionEn: Holds formal authority granted by the Invictus.

name: Kindred Status
description: Posição reconhecida em um Clã, Covenant ou domínio.
descriptionEn: Recognized standing in a Clan, Covenant, or domain.

name: Kiss of the Succubus
description: O Beijo cria uma ligação emocional excepcionalmente intensa.
descriptionEn: The Kiss creates an exceptionally intense emotional attachment.

name: Lineage
description: A descendência do vampiro é conhecida e carrega peso social.
descriptionEn: The vampire's descent is known and carries social weight.

name: Lorekeeper
description: Conserva e interpreta conhecimento oculto da Ordo Dracul.
descriptionEn: Preserves and interprets occult knowledge of the Ordo Dracul.

name: The Mother-Daughter Bond
description: Expressa um vínculo ritual profundo entre Acolytes.
descriptionEn: Expresses a deep ritual bond between Acolytes.

name: Night Doctor Surgery
description: Aplica práticas cirúrgicas experimentais da Ordo Dracul.
descriptionEn: Applies experimental surgical practices of the Ordo Dracul.

name: Speaker for the Silent
description: Interpreta sinais e revelações dos mortos silenciosos.
descriptionEn: Interprets signs and revelations from the silent dead.

name: Pack Alpha
description: Exerce domínio sobre animais ou uma matilha ligada ao vampiro.
descriptionEn: Exerts dominance over animals or a pack bound to the vampire.

name: Retainer(Ghoul)
description: Use the Retainer rules to create a ghoul servant. Add one dot of the regnant's Disciplines at Retainer 1-2, a second dot at 3-4, and a third dot at 5.
descriptionEn: Use the Retainer rules to create a ghoul servant. Add one dot of the regnant's Disciplines at Retainer 1-2, a second dot at 3-4, and a third dot at 5.

name: Unnatural Affinity
description: Permite alimentar-se de uma categoria sobrenatural incomum.
descriptionEn: Allows feeding from an unusual supernatural category.

name: Swarm Form
description: Expande Shape of the Beast para uma forma composta por muitos animais pequenos.
descriptionEn: Expands Shape of the Beast into a form composed of many small animals.

name: Secret Society Junkie
description: Reconhece padrões, rumores e protocolos de organizações ocultas.
descriptionEn: Recognizes the patterns, rumors, and protocols of hidden organizations.

name: Sworn
description: Está vinculado a um juramento reconhecido pelo Invictus.
descriptionEn: Is bound by an oath recognized by the Invictus.

name: I Know a Guy
description: Encontra rapidamente um contato adequado por meio da rede Carthiana.
descriptionEn: Quickly finds a suitable contact through the Carthian network.

name: Touchstone
description: Acrescenta ligações humanas que sustentam a Humanidade do vampiro.
descriptionEn: Adds human connections that sustain the vampire's Humanity.

name: Undead Menses
description: Produz um componente de sangue ritualmente significativo.
descriptionEn: Produces a ritually significant blood component.

name: Unsettling Gaze
description: O olhar do predador desestabiliza aqueles que o encaram.
descriptionEn: The predator's gaze unsettles those who meet it.

name: Where the Bodies Are Buried
description: Conhece segredos comprometedores da sociedade vampírica local.
descriptionEn: Knows compromising secrets of local Kindred society.

name: Lex Terrae
description: Faz o domínio responder a uma lei Carthiana reconhecida.
descriptionEn: Makes the domain answer to an established Carthian law.

name: Mandate from the Masses
description: A vontade coletiva reforça a autoridade Carthiana.
descriptionEn: Collective will reinforces Carthian authority.

name: Right of Return
description: A lei protege o direito de regressar a um território ou posição.
descriptionEn: The law protects the right to return to a territory or position.

name: Strength of Resolution
description: Uma resolução formal sustenta a determinação do Movimento.
descriptionEn: A formal resolution sustains the Movement's determination.

name: Plausible Deniability
description: A estrutura Carthiana protege participantes das consequências diretas.
descriptionEn: Carthian structure shields participants from direct consequences.

name: Notary
description: Reconhece, registra e testemunha juramentos do Invictus.
descriptionEn: Recognizes, records, and witnesses Invictus oaths.

name: Oath of Action
description: Vincula o juramentado à execução de uma tarefa definida.
descriptionEn: Binds the sworn vampire to perform a defined task.

name: Oath of Fealty
description: Formaliza lealdade entre vassalo e suserano.
descriptionEn: Formalizes loyalty between vassal and liege.

name: Oath of Penance
description: Impõe uma penitência formal e sobrenatural.
descriptionEn: Imposes a formal, supernatural penance.

name: Oath of Serfdom
description: Estabelece deveres e proteção entre senhor e servo.
descriptionEn: Establishes duties and protection between lord and servant.

name: Kindred Dueling
description: Manobras para enfrentar outros vampiros em combate próximo.
descriptionEn: Maneuvers for facing other vampires in close combat.

name: Riding the Wave
description: Técnicas para direcionar o frenesi sem suprimi-lo.
descriptionEn: Techniques for directing frenzy rather than suppressing it.

name: Alley Cat
description: In the streets of her home city, lowers the exceptional-success threshold for navigation, hiding, evasion, and pursuit as the rating rises.
descriptionEn: In the streets of her home city, lowers the exceptional-success threshold for navigation, hiding, evasion, and pursuit as the rating rises.

name: Army of One
description: Calls Carthian backup through Presence + Politics + Carthian Status; each dot provides one responder, with losses reducing the Merit under Sanctity of Merits.
descriptionEn: Calls Carthian backup through Presence + Politics + Carthian Status; each dot provides one responder, with losses reducing the Merit under Sanctity of Merits.
prerequisites: Carthian Movement Status equal to or greater than this Merit

name: Casual User
description: A non-member is treated as Status • for social access and Carthian Law consensus and may call on a one-dot Carthian Social Merit once per story.
descriptionEn: A non-member is treated as Status • for social access and Carthian Law consensus and may call on a one-dot Carthian Social Merit once per story.
prerequisites: Not a member of the Carthian Movement

name: Court Jester
description: Official retaliation for the character's open political criticism costs the official a dot of City Status and grants the character a Beat.
descriptionEn: Official retaliation for the character's open political criticism costs the official a dot of City Status and grants the character a Beat.

name: Devotion Experimenter
description: Experimental Devotions cost one Experience less, gain 9-again on activation, and can reward teaching them to another Kindred.
descriptionEn: Experimental Devotions cost one Experience less, gain 9-again on activation, and can reward teaching them to another Kindred.

name: Fucking Thief
description: Steals access to a one-dot advantage from another covenant at additional Experience cost, with failure treated as dramatic.
descriptionEn: Steals access to a one-dot advantage from another covenant at additional Experience cost, with failure treated as dramatic.

name: Jack-Booted Thug
description: Intimidates Kindred of equal or lower City Status into spending Willpower to oppose Carthians and penalizes their actions by City Status.
descriptionEn: Intimidates Kindred of equal or lower City Status into spending Willpower to oppose Carthians and penalizes their actions by City Status.
prerequisites: Carthian Movement Status ••; City Status •; Intimidation •••

name: Mobilize Outrage
description: A combat Style that turns Willpower and political fury into preemptive force, resistance to coercion, and refusal to fall during a fight.
descriptionEn: A combat Style that turns Willpower and political fury into preemptive force, resistance to coercion, and refusal to fall during a fight.

levels.name: Strike to Preempt
levels.description: On a first-turn attack, spend Willpower to add Willpower dots instead of +3; lose the next turn's action and Defense.

levels.name: Unbreakable
levels.description: In combat, spend Willpower to use Willpower dots instead of the normal bonus when resisting coercion.

levels.name: Dying on Your Feet
levels.description: Ignore wound penalties and lethal-damage torpor until combat ends; enter torpor afterward if the Health track is still full.

name: Sell Out
description: Maintains nominal standing across every covenant and may decide whether Carthian Law recognizes her as a Carthian.
descriptionEn: Maintains nominal standing across every covenant and may decide whether Carthian Law recognizes her as a Carthian.
prerequisites: Carthian Movement Status ••••; City Status ••••; Politics •••

name: Smooth Criminal
description: Once per story, ends a scene or debate by outmaneuvering an opponent with Manipulation + Subterfuge contested by Wits + Subterfuge.
descriptionEn: Once per story, ends a scene or debate by outmaneuvering an opponent with Manipulation + Subterfuge contested by Wits + Subterfuge.

name: Toss That Shit Right Back
description: Dodges a thrown weapon and, with excess successes, catches and immediately throws it back without allowing Defense.
descriptionEn: Dodges a thrown weapon and, with excess successes, catches and immediately throws it back without allowing Defense.

name: Breaking the Chains
description: A Carthian consensus replaces a subject's Vinculum with first-stage bonds to the participating Carthians.
descriptionEn: A Carthian consensus replaces a subject's Vinculum with first-stage bonds to the participating Carthians.

name: Cease Fire
description: A domain-wide Carthian consensus makes Disciplines and Devotions cost Willpower and punishes powers that already cost Willpower with aggravated damage.
descriptionEn: A domain-wide Carthian consensus makes Disciplines and Devotions cost Willpower and punishes powers that already cost Willpower with aggravated damage.

name: Coda Against Sorcery
description: Defines a class of sorcery or ritual; the rating penalizes its activation and protects against weaponized applications.
descriptionEn: Defines a class of sorcery or ritual; the rating penalizes its activation and protects against weaponized applications.

name: Empower Judiciary
description: Invests a judge with Vitae and Willpower to issue binding interpretations whose violation costs City Status or inflicts aggravated damage.
descriptionEn: Invests a judge with Vitae and Willpower to issue binding interpretations whose violation costs City Status or inflicts aggravated damage.

name: Establish Precedent
description: Turns a same-night legal judgment into a year-and-a-day precedent that brands and punishes conscious violations.
descriptionEn: Turns a same-night legal judgment into a year-and-a-day precedent that brands and punishes conscious violations.

name: Weaponize Dissent
description: For a year and a day, City Status adds directly to weapon damage in the law-holder's presence or near her remains.
descriptionEn: For a year and a day, City Status adds directly to weapon damage in the law-holder's presence or near her remains.

name: Chorister
description: A non-member gains limited Circle standing, may learn Crúac and Circle Merits, and converts the Merit into Status when formally joining.
descriptionEn: A non-member gains limited Circle standing, may learn Crúac and Circle Merits, and converts the Merit into Status when formally joining.
prerequisites: Not a member of the Circle of the Crone

name: Mandragora Garden
description: A blood-fed garden assists nearby rituals, sustains scene-long rites, and yields twice its rating in animal blood each month.
descriptionEn: A blood-fed garden assists nearby rituals, sustains scene-long rites, and yields twice its rating in animal blood each month.
prerequisites: Safe Place equal to this Merit; Crúac •

name: Temple Guardian
description: A defensive fighting Style for protecting fellow Acolytes and empowering their Crúac through sacrifice.
descriptionEn: A defensive fighting Style for protecting fellow Acolytes and empowering their Crúac through sacrifice.

levels.name: Athena's Armor
levels.description: Ignore the first point of damage from each attack during a turn spent on a non-attack action.

levels.name: Enyo's Defense
levels.description: Move up to Speed to intercept an attack made against an ally.

levels.name: Eris's Glory
levels.description: After suffering lethal or aggravated damage, inspire an ally and turn wound penalties into bonuses to allies' Crúac.

name: Viral Mythology
description: A witnessed divine display can seed belief in the character's mythology and doubles dots purchased in Allies or Herd for adherents.
descriptionEn: A witnessed divine display can seed belief in the character's mythology and doubles dots purchased in Allies or Herd for adherents.

name: What You've Done for Her Lately
translatedName: What You've Done for Her Lately
description: Once per story, a successful Crúac ritual adds its rating to effective Circle Status for the scene.
descriptionEn: Once per story, a successful Crúac ritual adds its rating to effective Circle Status for the scene.

name: Unbridled Chaos
description: A Crúac Style that invokes destructive change, escalating from damaged objects to warped life and violent weather.
descriptionEn: A Crúac Style that invokes destructive change, escalating from damaged objects to warped life and violent weather.

levels.name: Magnitude •
levels.description: Alter Structure or Durability within the ritual's reach.

levels.name: Magnitude ••
levels.description: Broaden destructive alteration to more substantial matter.

levels.name: Magnitude •••
levels.description: Mutate living forms within the ritual's scope.

levels.name: Magnitude ••••
levels.description: Produce severe transformations and environmental upheaval.

levels.name: Magnitude •••••
levels.description: Spend Willpower to create violent weather while remaining immune to its Tilts.

name: Primal Creation
description: A Crúac Style that accelerates fertility and growth and can create short-lived copies of living beings.
descriptionEn: A Crúac Style that accelerates fertility and growth and can create short-lived copies of living beings.

levels.name: Magnitude •
levels.description: Encourage plant growth and fertility.

levels.name: Magnitude ••
levels.description: Create increasingly complex living abundance.

levels.name: Magnitude •••
levels.description: Shape life on a broader scale.

levels.name: Magnitude ••••
levels.description: Spend Willpower to clone a living being of Size up to Magnitude.

levels.name: Magnitude •••••
levels.description: Create the Style's largest and most capable temporary life.

name: Opening the Void
description: A Crúac Style that summons creatures from outside the world or pulls a living victim through the void.
descriptionEn: A Crúac Style that summons creatures from outside the world or pulls a living victim through the void.

levels.name: Magnitude •
levels.description: Summon a small Retainer-like creature for one hour per ritual dot.

levels.name: Magnitude ••
levels.description: Summon a stronger and larger creature.

levels.name: Magnitude •••
levels.description: Summon a substantial void creature or begin drawing a victim through.

levels.name: Magnitude ••••
levels.description: Command a powerful summoned creature.

levels.name: Magnitude •••••
levels.description: Summon the Style's greatest creature or draw a heavily resisting victim through the void.

name: Courtoisie
description: An Invictus dueling Style that establishes a formal opponent, turns social bearing into combat competence, and forces attention.
descriptionEn: An Invictus dueling Style that establishes a formal opponent, turns social bearing into combat competence, and forces attention.

levels.name: Establish Duel
levels.description: Choose one foe; entering the duel's range harms interlopers and grants Weaponry as Defense against others.

levels.name: Value Spoken Word
levels.description: Substitute an appropriate Social Skill for Athletics or Weaponry, or Presence/Manipulation for Strength/Dexterity.

levels.name: Demanding Attention
levels.description: The chosen foe must engage while no greater threat exists; disengaging or attacking another causes lethal damage and Knocked Down.

name: Crowdsourcing
description: Temporarily transfers dots of specified Social Merits among Invictus members after a successful Manipulation + Academics action.
descriptionEn: Temporarily transfers dots of specified Social Merits among Invictus members after a successful Manipulation + Academics action.

name: Information Network
description: Treats relevant Contacts as Skill Specialties when acting on information they provide.
descriptionEn: Treats relevant Contacts as Skill Specialties when acting on information they provide.

name: Moderator
description: Once per story, uses the rating as remote Allies, Contacts, or Library through an online community.
descriptionEn: Once per story, uses the rating as remote Allies, Contacts, or Library through an online community.

name: One Foot in the Door
description: A non-member receives limited Invictus standing and a favor, converting the Merit into Status when formally joining.
descriptionEn: A non-member receives limited Invictus standing and a favor, converting the Merit into Status when formally joining.
prerequisites: Not a member of the Invictus

name: Noblesse Oblige
description: A formal political office can stand in place of a personal Touchstone.
descriptionEn: A formal political office can stand in place of a personal Touchstone.

name: Prestigious Sire
description: Uses a renowned sire's City, Clan, or Covenant Status in social situations, risking the Merit on failure.
descriptionEn: Uses a renowned sire's City, Clan, or Covenant Status in social situations, risking the Merit on failure.

name: Social Engineering
description: After an hour of preparation, Manipulation + Investigation can breach a Safe Place, suppress a Social Merit, alter Social actions, or reveal a weakness.
descriptionEn: After an hour of preparation, Manipulation + Investigation can breach a Safe Place, suppress a Social Merit, alter Social actions, or reveal a weakness.

name: Tech-Savvy
description: With an hour's preparation, improves a technological item's equipment bonus, Structure, or Durability and grants 9-again.
descriptionEn: With an hour's preparation, improves a technological item's equipment bonus, Structure, or Durability and grants 9-again.

name: Travel Agent
description: Obscures intercity travel, improves gifts from hosts, and can supply temporary Allies or Contacts in a new city.
descriptionEn: Obscures intercity travel, improves gifts from hosts, and can supply temporary Allies or Contacts in a new city.

name: Oath of Abstinence
description: The oathbound forgoes feeding under stated terms and avoids the normal Vitae cost to awaken while the abstinence holds.
descriptionEn: The oathbound forgoes feeding under stated terms and avoids the normal Vitae cost to awaken while the abstinence holds.

name: Oath of the Handshake Deal
description: Two parties swear a service or prohibition and pledge a Social Merit as collateral that transfers upon violation.
descriptionEn: Two parties swear a service or prohibition and pledge a Social Merit as collateral that transfers upon violation.
prerequisites: At least one party has Invictus Status

name: Oath of the Hard Motherfucker
description: A non-Invictus beneficiary receives Status, Allies, Contacts, Resources, and 9-again in two Skills while honoring the oath.
descriptionEn: A non-Invictus beneficiary receives Status, Allies, Contacts, Resources, and 9-again in two Skills while honoring the oath.
prerequisites: Not a member of the Invictus

name: Oath of Matrimony
description: The spouses share or equalize Social Merits, Blood Potency, a Discipline, blood sympathy, and a mutual third-stage bond.
descriptionEn: The spouses share or equalize Social Merits, Blood Potency, a Discipline, blood sympathy, and a mutual third-stage bond.
prerequisites: At least one party has Invictus Status

name: Oath of the Model Prisoner
description: The prisoner cannot escape or sabotage the captors, while the captors must feed and protect the prisoner from torture or unlawful execution.
descriptionEn: The prisoner cannot escape or sabotage the captors, while the captors must feed and protect the prisoner from torture or unlawful execution.

name: Oath of Office
description: A sworn office grants an additional Mask and lets relevant Status replace normal Willpower modifiers while its duties are honored.
descriptionEn: A sworn office grants an additional Mask and lets relevant Status replace normal Willpower modifiers while its duties are honored.

name: Oath of the Refugee
description: A Kindred renounces a domain and gains protection from its citizens while relocating, later exchanging the oath for new City and Invictus Status.
descriptionEn: A Kindred renounces a domain and gains protection from its citizens while relocating, later exchanging the oath for new City and Invictus Status.

name: Oath of the Righteous Kill
description: The oathbearer accepts the moral burden of another's premeditated killing and makes the detachment roll with a bonus.
descriptionEn: The oathbearer accepts the moral burden of another's premeditated killing and makes the detachment roll with a bonus.

name: Oath of the Safe Word
description: Two parties share one Social Merit and access to each other's Willpower pools until either invokes the safe word.
descriptionEn: Two parties share one Social Merit and access to each other's Willpower pools until either invokes the safe word.

name: Oath of the True Knight
description: Protects a sworn knight against coercion by Kindred and ghouls and grants armor against them, while violently rejecting other blood oaths.
descriptionEn: Protects a sworn knight against coercion by Kindred and ghouls and grants armor against them, while violently rejecting other blood oaths.
prerequisites: Invictus Status ••; no other oath or blood bond when sworn

name: Crusade
description: A Sanctified combat Style that disrupts sorcery, silences spellcasters, and breaks extended supernatural workings with a weapon strike.
descriptionEn: A Sanctified combat Style that disrupts sorcery, silences spellcasters, and breaks extended supernatural workings with a weapon strike.
prerequisites: Occult ••; Resolve •••; Weaponry ••; Theban Sorcery •• or Sorcerous Eunuch •

levels.name: Shield Against Sorcery
levels.description: While armed and retaining Defense, penalize hostile magic used within Willpower yards by the Style rating.

levels.name: Silence
levels.description: A targeted strike to the throat suffers no called-shot penalty and silences the victim.

levels.name: Hammer
levels.description: Spend Willpower and attack at −2 to abort a victim's extended supernatural action as a dramatic failure and add its rating to damage.

name: Flock
description: Expands a Herd into a faithful congregation whose members begin scenes with Willpower and restore it through feeding.
descriptionEn: Expands a Herd into a faithful congregation whose members begin scenes with Willpower and restore it through feeding.
prerequisites: Herd equal to or greater than this Merit

name: Laity
description: A non-member receives limited Sanctified standing and a favor, converting the Merit into Status when formally joining.
descriptionEn: A non-member receives limited Sanctified standing and a favor, converting the Merit into Status when formally joining.
prerequisites: Not a member of the Lancea et Sanctum

name: Sanctuary
description: Confines one criminal Retainer •••• per dot within a Safe Place, requiring upkeep but supplying controlled feeding.
descriptionEn: Confines one criminal Retainer •••• per dot within a Safe Place, requiring upkeep but supplying controlled feeding.
prerequisites: City Status ••; Lancea et Sanctum Status ••; Safe Place •

name: Sorcerous Eunuch
description: Supernatural magic targeting the character suffers a Resolve-based penalty, but the character can never learn blood sorcery.
descriptionEn: Supernatural magic targeting the character suffers a Resolve-based penalty, but the character can never learn blood sorcery.

name: Stigmata
description: Bleeds sacred Vitae or blood each week, empowering feeders and Theban Sorcery while causing recurring injury.
descriptionEn: Bleeds sacred Vitae or blood each week, empowering feeders and Theban Sorcery while causing recurring injury.
prerequisites: Humanity at least this Merit + 3, or mortal

name: Temple of Damnation
description: A dedicated Safe Place supports actions aligned with its doctrine and lets worshippers receive blessings and remote Theban targeting.
descriptionEn: A dedicated Safe Place supports actions aligned with its doctrine and lets worshippers receive blessings and remote Theban targeting.
prerequisites: Safe Place equal to or greater than this Merit

name: Independent Study
description: A non-member receives limited Order standing and a favor, converting the Merit into Status when formally joining.
descriptionEn: A non-member receives limited Order standing and a favor, converting the Merit into Status when formally joining.
prerequisites: Not a member of the Ordo Dracul

name: Nest Guardian
description: Grants reliable access to a Wyrm's Nest and adds the rating to perception on its grounds.
descriptionEn: Grants reliable access to a Wyrm's Nest and adds the rating to perception on its grounds.
prerequisites: Access to a Wyrm's Nest of equal or higher rating

name: Rites of the Impaled
description: A combat Style that turns pain into power, delays torpor, and retaliates with an attacker's own momentum.
descriptionEn: A combat Style that turns pain into power, delays torpor, and retaliates with an attacker's own momentum.

levels.name: Passion Through Pain
levels.description: Invert wound penalties into bonuses.

levels.name: Beyond the Pale
levels.description: Do not enter torpor from a Health track filled with lethal damage unless aggravated damage meets Resolve.

levels.name: Action/Reaction
levels.description: After taking damage, spend Willpower and the next action to counterattack using the attacker's successes and ignoring Defense.

name: Twilight Judge
description: Issues authoritative Ordo rulings backed by Status and gains a powerful Mentor within the covenant.
descriptionEn: Issues authoritative Ordo rulings backed by Status and gains a powerful Mentor within the covenant.

name: Chapterhouse
description: Within the Nest, adds the rating to resist frenzy or end violent action and subtracts it from attempts to Lash Out.
descriptionEn: Within the Nest, adds the rating to resist frenzy or end violent action and subtracts it from attempts to Lash Out.

name: Crucible
description: Reduces the Experience cost of Coils from a chosen Mystery and of Scales learned within the Nest.
descriptionEn: Reduces the Experience cost of Coils from a chosen Mystery and of Scales learned within the Nest.

name: Feng Shui
description: Attunes one chosen Skill to the Wyrm's Nest, adding the Merit rating to uses of that Skill on the grounds.
descriptionEn: Attunes one chosen Skill to the Wyrm's Nest, adding the Merit rating to uses of that Skill on the grounds.

name: Perilous Nest
description: Creates a supernatural hazard in the Nest that attacks matching intruders each turn with twice the Merit rating.
descriptionEn: Creates a supernatural hazard in the Nest that attacks matching intruders each turn with twice the Merit rating.
